scene: You climb up onto a rooftop transit hub bustling with departing vessels.
picture: Flat side view along a high rooftop platform. On the left, a wooden solar-sail junk sits moored with unfurled sails. Left-centre, the player stands with his ukulele and top knot. Up high runs an elevated rail with a maglev dragon train. On the right, a streamlined pink bullet train waits with open doors beside turnstiles.
shown: A docked solar-sail junk tied to a wooden mooring post on the left
A coiled maglev dragon train waiting on glowing rails up high
